title: Donald Gets His Sack!
paragraph: Aaron Donald and the Rams faced the Cardinals in Arizona. In the second quarter, Donald sacked quarterback Carson Beck. It was his first sack in 1,050 days! Matthew Stafford also threw a touchdown pass to Tyler Higbee. The Rams won 34-6, making it a memorable day for Donald.

big_words.definition: Special enough to remember for a long time.
big_words.example: Sofia had a memorable day showing her science project.

source_title: Rams' Aaron Donald savors first sack in 1,050 days vs. Cardinals - ESPN
angle: Rams star Aaron Donald made his first sack in 1,050 days, and his team won too!

title: Parker Helps Jaguars Roar
paragraph: The Jaguars faced the Titans in Tennessee. Parker Washington caught a 2-yard touchdown pass from Trevor Lawrence. He got his feet down at the back of the end zone! Washington also made a dazzling 20-yard toe-tap catch. He had 148 receiving yards in the first half. His big day helped Jacksonville beat its rival 40-23.

big_words.definition: So impressive that it amazes people.
big_words.example: Jamal made a dazzling splash at his swimming lesson.

source_title: Five Key Plays From Jaguars' Week 10 Win Over Titans
angle: Parker Washington helped the Jaguars roar past their rival Titans 40-23.

title: Chuba Powers the Panthers
paragraph: Chuba Hubbard had a remarkable day in New Orleans. He ran for 92 yards and caught passes for 80 more. He scored a touchdown on a 2-yard run. Then he ran one yard for another touchdown! With time running out, Ryan Fitzgerald kicked a 54-yard field goal! The kick gave Carolina a 20-17 win over the Saints.

big_words.definition: So special that people notice it.
big_words.example: Hana's dog did a remarkable trick with a ball.

source_title: Is Chuba Hubbard the X factor to spark Panthers' turnaround? - ESPN
angle: Chuba Hubbard scored two touchdowns and piled up rushing and receiving yards in the Panthers' close win.

title: No Tie This Time!
paragraph: The Commanders and Giants met again after a 27-27 tie. This time, Cam Skattebo ran for two Giants touchdowns. Jayden Daniels tossed two touchdown passes to keep Washington close. Then Daniels found Stefon Diggs for a 32-yard touchdown! That splendid play came with 57 seconds left. Washington won 24-21, so this time there was a winner.

big_words.example: Diego built a splendid tower with his blocks.

source_title: Week 10 TNF Commanders at Giants: Highlights, key plays - ESPN
angle: The Commanders and Giants faced off again after their last game ended in a 27-27 tie.

title: 49ers Light Up Dallas
paragraph: The 49ers brought a magnificent offense to Dallas. Brock Purdy tossed a 74-yard touchdown pass to Christian McCaffrey. Deebo Samuel raced 70 yards for another touchdown! Later, Purdy found McCaffrey for a 66-yard touchdown. The 49ers beat the Cowboys 46-40. Their offense showed it could score from far away.

big_words.example: Ava found a magnificent library book about the stars.

source_title: 49ers put up big numbers in victory over Cowboys - ESPN
angle: The 49ers showed off an explosive offense in a victory over the Cowboys.
